cap: The position of a scrotal swelling and whether light passes through it narrow the diagnosis. Fluid collections, a hydrocele around the testis and a spermatocele above and behind it, transilluminate; blood (hematocele), dilated veins (varicocele) and solid tissue (germ cell tumor) do not. A firm, painless mass that cannot be separated from the testis is treated as cancer until proven otherwise.
